channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-08-21 — late-cycle
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 325¢/lb — down 3.9% on the week and up 5.0% on the month. The regime model reads the market as late-cycle (selective posture) and has for 34 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (+0.8σ). The crop is in its fruit filling window, and stage-weighted stress is low. The Brazilian real is little changed on the month (+1.5%) — a neutral currency backdrop.
